description:
Surface and delta tracking are two independent programs with disjoint signatures and zero shared code, and both duplicate the power iteration (transport_csg.rs:300-412 vs keff_delta.rs:623-692).

This is a rewrite of both, not a refactor. Retire the duplicated power iteration in the same change. Also unify the two incompatible source samplers (SourceBox rejection at transport_csg.rs:303-326 vs domain.sample_point at keff_delta.rs:634).

Note the delta path has NO Tally at all - zero hits in keff_delta.rs - so tally consistency across methods is part of this.
title: Phase 1.4: one transport loop replacing the two drivers
